title: Rework accessible mini-widget density and ARIA announcements for compact data controls
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Issue to audit and remediate accessibility gaps in the 'mini widgets' family: compact table rows, condensed chart legends, inline badges, and cell action menus. Focus areas: keyboard navigation for dense focusable targets, semantic ARIA roles for grouped controls, screen-reader announcement strategy for dynamic updates (ARIA-live / polite/assertive patterns), and contrast token updates for compact states. Deliverables include updated tokens, component API changes, QA test checklist, and VPAT artifact updates.
acceptance_criteria: All mini-widget components (compact table row, compact chart legend, inline badge group, cell action menu) have documented keyboard focus order with no tab traps
ARIA roles and attributes updated: group/toolbar semantics where appropriate, each interactive element has a clear role and accessible name
Screen-reader announcement behavior defined and implemented for state changes (selection, inline edits, filter applied) with minimal verbosity and correct live region politeness levels
Contrast for text/icons in compact states meets WCAG AA (4.5:1) across light and dark tokens or documented exception with compensating controls
Design tokens updated and included in token migration plan; changes surfaced in token docs and token diff artifact
VPAT annex updated with examples and test results for these components and signed-off by Accessibility PM
QA regression checklist passes on Chrome+NVDA, Safari+VoiceOver, and Firefox+NVDA for the applicable OS matrix
steps: Run component-level accessibility audit for mini-widgets using axe and manual walkthroughs
Map failing cases to design decisions and token gaps; propose concrete token changes and component API adjustments
Create Figma prototypes for new focus rings, spacing, and live-region placements; iterate with Eng and PM
Implement tokens and component changes in the design system branch; include snapshot tests and storybook accessibility stories
Coordinate a cross-team QA pass and capture VPAT evidence (screen recordings, test results, WCAG report)
Update VPAT annex and ship patch release notes for design-token migration
design_notes: We intentionally favor slightly increased touch-target area for keyboard focus (expand visible focus ring area) while keeping visual density. For compact chart legends, move interactive legend items into a grouped toolbar with role=toolbar and aria-label describing the series group. Use aria-pressed for toggleable legend chips. For inline badge groups, add aria-roledescription='filter' and ensure each badge has aria-checked when used as a filter toggle. Live-region strategy: use a single, centralized polite region at the top of the mini-widget container for status updates (selection changed, filters applied) and an assertive, short toast only for errors. Provide a toggle in Console for customers to opt into verbose live announcements for screen-reader users who prefer more context.
decisions: Adopt role=toolbar for compact chart legend groups to enable arrow-key navigation
Use aria-live='polite' for non-error status updates and aria-live='assertive' only for critical failures
Prioritize token contrast changes for compact text/icon states over density reductions; increase contrast ramp by one step where needed
Expose new 'focusZone' boolean prop on compact components to opt into consolidated keyboard handling
